title: Call a lead and log what happened

say: Let's make your first call from Sales X-Ray.
चलिए, Sales X-Ray से आपका पहला call करते हैं.
caption: Chaliye, Sales X-Ray se aapka pehla call karte hain.

say: चला, Sales X-Ray मधून तुमचा पहिला call करूया.
caption: Chala, Sales X-Ray madhun tumcha pahila call karuya.

say: Open Leads.
The To call tab shows everyone you should call today, with late ones on top.
Leads खोलिए.
To call tab में आज जिनको call करना है, वो सब दिखते हैं. Late वाले सबसे ऊपर.
caption: Leads kholiye.
To call tab mein aaj jinko call karna hai, woh sab dikhte hain. Late waale sabse upar.

say: Leads उघडा.
To call tab मध्ये आज ज्यांना call करायचाय, ते सगळे दिसतात. Late वाले सगळ्यात वर.
caption: Leads ughda.
To call tab madhye aaj jyanna call karaychay, te sagle distat. Late wale saglyat var.

say: Tap a lead to open it.
Their story, notes and calls are all on this one page.
किसी भी lead पे tap कीजिए.
उसकी पूरी story, notes और calls, सब एक ही page पे.
caption: Kisi bhi lead pe tap kijiye.
Uski poori story, notes aur calls, sab ek hi page pe.

say: कुठल्याही lead वर tap करा.
त्याची पूर्ण story, notes आणि calls, सगळं एकाच page वर.
caption: Kuthlyahi lead var tap kara.
Tyachi poorna story, notes aani calls, sagla ekach page var.

say: Tap Call, and your phone dials right away.
Prefer a message? WhatsApp and SMS are right next to it.
Call दबाइए, phone तुरंत number लगा देता है.
Message भेजना है? WhatsApp और SMS बगल में ही हैं.
caption: Call dabaiye, phone turant number laga deta hai.
Message bhejna hai? WhatsApp aur SMS bagal mein hi hain.

say: Call दाबा, phone लगेच number लावतो.
Message पाठवायचाय? WhatsApp आणि SMS बाजूलाच आहेत.
caption: Call daba, phone lagech number lavto.
Message pathvaychay? WhatsApp aani SMS bajulach aahet.

target.text: How did the call with Asha go?

say: After the call, tell Sales X-Ray how it went.
We talked, No answer, or Didn't get through. One tap, and the next step is set.
Call के बाद, बस बताइए call कैसा रहा.
We talked, No answer, या Didn't get through. एक tap, और next step set.
caption: Call ke baad, bas bataiye call kaisa raha.
We talked, No answer, ya Didn't get through. Ek tap, aur next step set.

say: Call झाल्यावर, फक्त सांगा call कसा झाला.
We talked, No answer, किंवा Didn't get through. एक tap, आणि next step set.
caption: Call jhalyavar, fakt saanga call kasa jhala.
We talked, No answer, kinva Didn't get through. Ek tap, aani next step set.

say: Got a long list?
Tap Start calling.
लंबी list है?
Start calling दबाइए.
caption: Lambi list hai?
Start calling dabaiye.

say: मोठी list आहे?
Start calling दाबा.
caption: Mothi list aahe?
Start calling daba.

say: Sales X-Ray brings up the next lead in line, with your opener and replies ready.
Call, log, next. That's it.
Sales X-Ray अगला lead सामने ला देता है, opener और जवाब ready के साथ.
Call, log, next. बस इतना ही.
caption: Sales X-Ray agla lead saamne la deta hai, opener aur jawaab ready ke saath.
Call, log, next. Bas itna hi.

say: Sales X-Ray पुढचा lead समोर आणतो, opener आणि उत्तरं ready सकट.
Call, log, next. बस एवढंच.
caption: Sales X-Ray pudhcha lead samor aanto, opener aani uttara ready sakat.
Call, log, next. Bas evdhach.
